gaps.title: Add TraitGazeFocusAnalytics for XR presentation analytics (A-009 example-driven request)
gaps.description: While refreshing examples/vr-meeting-room.refreshed.holo (a multi-user VR conference room), a missing trait was identified: @gaze_focus_analytics. The scene needs to track where networked meeting participants look during a presentation — specifically which slide regions or objects receive dwell attention. This would produce a per-object heatmap accumulated from XR eye-tracking across all peers. No current Trait*.ts implements this. Suggested API shape: @gaze_focus_analytics { resolution: [16, 9], decay_rate_s: 30.0, export_event: 'session_end', export_format: 'json' }. The trait would accumulate gaze vectors from each peer's eye-tracking stream, project them into UV space on each object, and emit a heatmap blob on session end. Directly unlocks meeting-analytics, training/simulation review, and accessibility UX auditing use cases.
